progress.press_key: Press any physical key on the CDWX8 remote you want to add within 30 seconds.

bluetooth_ready.title: Jiuhao CDWX8 remote discovered
bluetooth_ready.description: Found a remote at {address}. Continue, then press any physical key on this remote.

scan_timeout.title: No recognizable key press received
scan_timeout.description: Move the remote closer to the Bluetooth receiver and press a key after starting a new scan. You can also enter measured values.

confirm.title: Confirm remote setup
confirm.description: Read MAC {address} and the UUID prefix from the key advertisement. Confirm to add this remote.

manual.title: Set up a Jiuhao CDWX8 remote
manual.description: Enter the measured six-byte prefix from a button advertisement. Use the byte order in the raw packet, for example 01 01 02 03 04 05.

error.invalid_address: Enter six hexadecimal octets separated by colons.
error.invalid_prefix: Enter exactly six hexadecimal bytes. Spaces are allowed.

abort.unsupported_address: This scanner did not provide the remote's Bluetooth MAC address.
